mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, book_id AS bookId, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM book_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND book_id = #{bookId}

SELECT bf.id AS favoriteId, bf.book_id AS bookId, b.title, b.author, SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.cover_image, ',', 1) AS coverImage, b.price, b.original_price AS originalPrice, b.status AS bookStatus, bf.created_at AS favoriteTime FROM book_favorite bf INNER JOIN book b ON bf.book_id = b.id WHERE bf.user_id = #{userId} AND bf.status = 1 AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.is_banned = 0 ORDER BY bf.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_favorite bf INNER JOIN book b ON bf.book_id = b.id WHERE bf.user_id = #{userId} AND bf.status = 1 AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.is_banned = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_favorite (user_id, book_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), updated_at = NOW()
